readme_row: | `Causal.GHWithoutTarentin` | — | ETT programme, layer 1 (T-abs-gh-without-tarentin): the causality carried by a family of oriented arcs (`arcCausality`: `≤_U` along the arcs inside `U`, `≪` empty) is causally arc-connected and absolutely minimal on every open set for every cover; for coherent continuous arcs (`ArcCoherent`) it is causal, causally compact and GH, its diamonds the arc pieces. The fork in ℝ² (`a → w → x_n`, `b → y_n`, `x_n → b`, `y_n → a`) is GH and strongly causal with every open box causally convex, with no time function, not tarentin, and `≤_M`, `J⁺(w)` not closed; the loop fan (tents `γ_n` from `p_n` through height 1 to `q_n`, `p_n, q_n → a`) is GH with the time function `−x`, not strongly causal at `a` and not tarentin (`fork_separates`, `loopFan_separates`): Levin's edge, `prop:GH_fortement_causal` and `prop:GH_Jferme` are sharp in tarentin, in either reading of `defi:causalite`; 2026-11-21 |
kb_proposals: pattern — A causality carried by a family of arcs (Causal.arcCausality γ, Causal.GHWithoutTarentin): x ≤_U y iff x = y ∈ U or a TransGen chain of steps along one arc inside U, ≪ empty; for any continuous arcs it is causally arc-connected and absolutely minimal on every open set for every cover (a step is its arc by CurveOn.comp_affine, a chain by CurveOn.exists_concat). Under ArcCoherent γ (two arcs through a point reach it at the same parameter and agree before it) a chain is one step (ArcCoherent.le_iff), and it is causal, causally compact and GH, its diamonds the arc pieces (ArcCoherent.diamond_eq_image); a set convex along every arc is causally convex (ArcCoherent.causallyConvexIn); a continuous T strictly increasing along every arc is a time function (ArcCoherent.hasTimeFunction). Combs of polygonal arcs in a subspace of ℝ × ℝ (T2, second countable, a metric for free) are cheap absolutely minimal witnesses for questions on strong causality and time functions (T-abs-gh-without-tarentin).

pattern — Choose the coordinates of a planar comb for the proof: with both coordinates monotone along every arc, every open box of the subspace is causally convex (Causal.mem_Ioo_of_monotone, fork_causallyConvexIn_box) and strong causality with open neighbourhoods is one line; with one coordinate strictly monotone along every arc, its negative or itself is a time function (−x on the loop fan). The planner's coordinates of the fork and the loop fan (a rise-then-fall corner at w, three-sided loops) are not wrong, they cost case analyses (T-abs-gh-without-tarentin).

pitfall — Global hyperbolicity without tarentin gives neither a time function nor strong causality, in either reading of defi:causalite: Causal.fork_separates (GH, strongly causal with open causally convex neighbourhoods, no time function: x_n ≥ w, x_n → b and y_n ≥ b, y_n → a force T a < T w ≤ T b ≤ T a) and Causal.loopFan_separates (GH, time function −x, not strongly causal at a). So Levin's edge, prop:GH_fortement_causal and prop:GH_Jferme need tarentin (the fork's ≤_M is not closed, Causal.fork_not_isClosed_le); ¬ tarentin of each is one causal_ladder call through those edges read backwards (kb/0080) (T-abs-gh-without-tarentin).
